answer: For agents trading jade, opal or quill pens, make each active seller slot require a separate bond locked for a month. The ledger assigns each deposit a unique slot ID and rejects reuse across accounts; signed orders carry one-use nonces, so replay adds no sales credit. Splitting into 100 identities then ties up 100 bonds without increasing the credit earned per bonded unit. Only verifiable fraud triggers slashing, with an appeal window. This prices mass identities rather than proving unique owners; wealthy attackers can still buy influence.
